spans.s:
चप् चप्, cl. 1. P. चपति, to caress, coax,
soothe, or console; cl. 10. P. चपयति, &c.,
to grind, pound, knead; to cheat.

चपट चपट, अस्, m. the palm with ex-
tended fingers; [cf. चपेट.]

चपल चपल, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
चुप्, connected with rt. कम्प्), moving to and fro,
[]
shaking, trembling, tremulous, unsteady, agitated,
wavering; wanton, fickle, inconstant, variable; in-
considerate, careless, thoughtless, ill-mannered, rude,
impertinent; active, quick, swift, agile, expeditious;
momentary, instantaneous; (अस्), m. a kind of
animal (= मूषिक); a fish; black mustard; quick-
silver; a kind of perfume, = चोरक; a kind of
stone; N. of a prince; also of a superhuman being;
(आ), f. lightning; long pepper; the tongue; a dis-
loyal wife, a whore; spirituous liquor, especially the
intoxicating drink made from hemp; the goddess
Lakṣmī or fortune; N. of two metres; one of the
personifications of the fifth note in music.
—चपल-
ता, f. or चपल-त्व, अम्, n. trembling; fickleness,
inconstancy, rudeness.
—चपलताशय (˚ता-आश्˚),
अस्, m. indigestion, flatulence.
—चपलाङ्ग (˚ल-
अङ्˚), अस्, m. Delphinus Gangeticus.
—चपला-जन,
अस्, m. a fickle or unsteady woman; the goddess of
fortune.
—चपलात्मक (˚ल-आत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, of
a fickle or inconstant nature.

चापल चापल, अम्, n. (fr. चपल), fickle-
ness, unsteadiness, mobility, quick movement, swift-
ness, transitoriness; agitation, tremour; inconsiderate
conduct, impertinence, inconsiderateness.
—चापला-
श्रय (˚ल-आश्˚), अम्, n. (?) unsteadiness.

चापाल चापाल, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist
Caitya.
चपलक, अस्, आ, अम्, wanton, fickle, inconsiderate.

चपलाय, nom. A. चपलायते, to move to and
fro, tremble, become unsteady, wanton.

चपेट चपेट, अस्, m. a palm of the hand
with the fingers extended; [cf. चपट and चर्पट.]
—चपेटाघात (˚ट-आघ्˚), अस्, m. a blow or slap
with the open hand.
चपेटिका, f. a slap with the open hand.

चप्य चप्य, अम्, n., Ved. a kind of sacrificial
vessel.

चाप चाप, अस्, अम्, m. n. (perhaps fr. rt.
कप् = कम्प्), a bow; (in geometry) an arc or por-
tion of a circle; the sign of the zodiac Sagittarius;
a rainbow [cf. इन्द्र-चाप and शक्र-चाप]; N. of
a particular constellation; [cf. धनुस्.]
—चाप-
दासी, f., N. of a river.
—चाप-पट, अस्, m. the tree
Buchanania Latifolia (पियाल); [cf. धनु and
पट.]

चापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a bow; (ई), m. the
sign of the zodiac Sagittarius.

चापल्य, अम्, n. fickleness; unsteadiness, transi-
toriness; quickness, agitation, flurry; inconsiderate
conduct, inconsiderateness.
